hook: Ampily Vijay is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Digital and Technology Officer, CBRE Investments, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Ampily Vijay's LinkedIn profile, the current post, executive vice president and chief digital and technology officer for CBRE (BOE and Investment Management), began in January 2026.

editor_points.desc: According to Ampily Vijay's LinkedIn profile: EVP and chief digital and technology officer, CBRE (BOE and Investment Management), since January 2026; chief digital and technology officer, CBRE Investment Management, from 2024 to 2026; SVP and global head of digital strategy from 2021 to 2024; VP of digital strategy at MetLife from 2018 to 2021; SVP of global digital strategy at Citi from 2014 to 2018; consultant at Boston Consulting Group in Sydney from 2012 to 2014; senior product manager at Oracle from 2006 to 2012. MBA, NYU Stern. The profile is Ampily Vijay's own account and has not been checked against other records.
